findings_resolved.F01: Resolved: Removed duplicate U_k in a_k; a_k = B_k(I_i) Q_k A_k(delta) using B0=Q0=A0=1.
findings_resolved.F02: Resolved: Separated orientation P(M)=P(-M) (B_odd=0) from unpolarized helicity summation extinguishing odd ranks in W(theta); rank truncated by min(2I_i, 2L_max).
findings_resolved.F03: Resolved: Standardized on Krane--Steffen (KS) convention with positive interference +2*delta*F_k; delta_KS = -delta_RB in emission; M1 unit aligned with 5.9 and Appendix A (M_S = M_mu/c).
findings_resolved.F04: Resolved: Clebsch-Gordan ordering in B_k documented: B_k = (-1)^k B_k^Hamilton; odd ranks differ by sign, even ranks identical; B0=1 holds for all normalized populations.
findings_resolved.F05: Resolved: Explicit polarization definition P = (W_parallel - W_perp)/(W_parallel + W_perp); associated Legendre factor 2*sqrt((k-2)!/(k+2)!); separated Q_k^pol from analyzing power Q(E); instrumental asymmetry a = N_perp^0 / N_parallel^0; Hamilton Ch. 12 & 15 cited.
findings_resolved.F06: Resolved: Spurious roots from cleared denominators screened via D(delta*) != 0; projective coordinates delta = u/v with pure multipole endpoint v=0 analyzed; degenerate and linear cases categorized; all physical branches preserved without model pruning.
findings_resolved.F07: Resolved: DCO single-detector efficiency factorization and multidetector pair weighting stated; cascade time-ordering in directional correlation formulated via Racah recoupling.
findings_resolved.F08: Resolved: Figure script positivity proven analytically (W +/- H > 0, D > 0); artificial np.clip removed; legend labeled Hypothetical Band; caption states algebraic didactic model.
findings_resolved.F09: Resolved: Hamilton locators corrected in ledger: PDF 529/532, 550, 553, 555, 556, 557, 563, 569 (Ch. 12) and PDF 727–728 (Ch. 15); PDF 355 identified as Ch. 10 internal conversion and purged.
findings_resolved.F10: Resolved: Q_k scalar attenuation requires axially symmetric detector response w(Omega) >= 0 with Q0=1, |Q_k| <= 1; spin orientation width determined by calibration or systematic envelope.
